interface.widths: All ports are one bit as explicitly specified.

semantics.p1y: NAND of p1a, p1b, p1c, p1d
semantics.p2y: NAND of p2a, p2b, p2c, p2d
semantics.timing: Combinational: the original specifies two 4-input NAND gates and no clock or latency.
semantics.reset_initialization: No reset, state, or initialization is specified or needed for combinational gates.

numeric.domain: One-bit logical inputs and outputs; no arithmetic or signedness.
numeric.truth_table: Each output is 0 exactly when all four corresponding binary inputs are 1; otherwise it is 1.

verification.oracle: Independent truth-table predicate per gate from the original two 4-input NAND gate specification.
verification.coverage: All 256 combinations of eight binary inputs, including all-high, all-low, and each single-low gate input.
verification.sampling: Wait 1 ns after each input change for combinational settling.
verification.failure_success: $fatal on any mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all vectors.

specification_ambiguities: Four-state X/Z behavior is not explicitly specified; use normal Verilog bitwise NAND semantics. Binary truth-table behavior is fully specified.
